headline: Norse Atlantic Suspends Flights and Lessors Demand Jets Back
summary: Norse Atlantic has suspended all flights after describing its financial situation as critical and warning it could file for bankruptcy unless it secures emergency funding, prompting lessors to demand their aircraft back.
why: Airline insolvencies and lessor repossessions immediately impact aircraft asset values, leasing company earnings, and international aviation capacity.

impacts.name: Norse Atlantic
impacts.why: Flight suspensions and potential bankruptcy proceedings threaten equity and debt holders.
